title: Phone does not receive readings or it lost a lot of them
body:
Hi! My son uses Blucon since last week. He has FreeStyle sensor and the phone is Aquarius U with Android 7.1.1   First 4 days he had Blucon all day and it was perfect. We are using xdrip-plus-20171113-20a4313-2
After those 4 days he put Blucon off, and put it on again at night. It seemed to work properly but when he went to sleep the alarm of no receive data sound 3 times. It did not received data for hours, but received a few ones. Next day we changed battery. First it worked very well, at night again lots of readings lost. Next day we could not even start because it kept on getting initial readings for hours.
We proved another phone and got initial readings but not any more.
Can anyone help me please?????? First 4 days we were so so so happy because nights were fantastic, now we are very disapointed.
The picture is about one night. 5 readings only in 8 hours. The blucon was properly attached to the freestyle sensor.
![20171214_144753 1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34598990/34070179-2b6d1444-e261-11e7-85bc-366f18ee4a41.jpg)

  El dom., dic. 17, 2017 a 22:16, dabear<notifications@github.com> escribió:   
@merberaza The error you are getting, error 0003 has been seen only a few times before, but it has always been indicative of problems with communicating with the blucon, possibly due to a bad battery. What brand of battery are you using? So far, we've confirmed that the following models work out allright: Duracell dl2032 and GP Lithium CR2032-7C5.

I suggest you try the following;
   
   - Delete any other app interfering with blucon, if you have glimp or the official software from Ambrosiasys, delete these from your phone
   - Update your phone to latest android available for your phone
   - Try one of the models of batteries confirmed to work out ok.
   - Finally, if nothing else works, and you are using the very latest xdrip nightly, send your logs via the app, so that we can inspect its full contents.

@merberaza so the problem is probably related to bluetooth reconnecting settings.
Please do both points below and report back:

1. Under settings->less common settings->other misc options:
ENABLE "Run collector in foreground"

2. Under settings->less common settings->bluetooth settings:
Disable "bluetooth watchdog"
Disable "bluetooth wakelocks"

Point 2 might seem counter intuitive, but please do it any way and report back.
